create.name: Daijihi – Soto Zen Sangha Österreich
create.bio:
Daijihi is a small Soto Zen community in Vienna's thirteenth district, belonging to the Sanshin Zen Community that Shohaku Okumura started in 1996 in Bloomington, Indiana, and recognised by the Sotoshu, the Japanese Soto school. It is guided by the priest Shinko Andreas Hagn, who also sits with prisoners as a Buddhist chaplain, together with Koryu Susanne Halbeisen, ordained in the Sanshin line in 2023, who teaches qigong. Most of the sangha are lay people, so the timetable fits around work and family life, and the majority of sessions can be joined on Zoom as well as in person.

Zazen is held early on four weekday mornings, with a Friday evening sit followed by a reading group and a Saturday morning ceremony. On some Sundays the whole morning is given to sitting, chanting, a talk or sharing, work practice and robe-sewing, and the group also runs half-day zazenkai and longer sesshin, including a plain 'no toys' form with long sits and no talks. The Daijihi House offers guest rooms, a flat for people who need a quiet place and spiritual support for a few weeks, and shared living for committed practitioners. The priests also lead weddings and funerals for people outside the sangha. The YouTube channel holds German Dharma talks, sesshin recordings and a chanted Heart Sutra.

courses.title: Zen-Einführungen
courses.description: A one-hour Friday evening introduction in Vienna with Shinko Andreas Hagn, covering the zazen posture and the basics of Soto Zen; no experience needed. Dates in the coming weeks are 20 November and 11 December 2026, and booking ahead is required.

courses.title: Praxissonntag
courses.description: A Sunday morning of practice on selected dates, with two periods of zazen, recitation, a Dharma talk or sharing round, work practice and robe-sewing, ending with a shared lunch. Booking ahead is requested.

courses.title: Sesshin und Zazenkai
courses.description: Half-day zazenkai and multi-day sesshin, either in classic Soto style with ceremonies, talks, dokusan and oryoki meals, or in the Sanshin style of long silent sits with no talks or ceremonies, aimed at people with some zazen experience.

flags: Base: Jakob-Stainer-Gasse 17, 1130 Vienna, from the practice-times page.
Founded year not stated on the site; left null.
Teachers Shinko Andreas Hagn and Koryu Susanne Halbeisen are not on Spiritpedia; teachers file empty. Koryu was ordained by Doryu Cappelli of Centro Anshin, Rome (lead 1969 in this batch).

The Daijihi House page describes the house as 'supportive, healing and holding' for people in need, and offers a supported flat for people seeking spiritual support; a social and pastoral project, no health claims. Wednesday qigong (and qigong with Neidan on the homepage) is a practice class, not a health offering.
Channel is small (158 subscribers) with infrequent uploads; latest 29 Sep 2026.
Linked tea shop Shinkoko.at is the founders' business; not included.
left_out: Podium discussion of the '1000 Hände' association; short trailers and clips under 3 minutes.
Silvester-Sitzen (New Year's Eve sitting with fire ritual and dance party): a party night rather than a teaching offering.
Guest-room stays (30–50 euro) and rituals for weddings and funerals: services, not courses.
Weekday zazen and qigong times: covered in the bio.
